content: Acejjeɛ i uɛawed n řebni n Zzawect Tameqqrant

Deg useggʷas wiss tnayen n ujeǧid Dariyus, deg uyur wiss setta, deg wass amezwaru n uyur, yusa-dd wawař n SIDI, s ufus n Ḥaggay, anabi, ɣar Zarubbabil, mmis n Ca’altiyal, lwali n Yahuda, u ɣar Yahucaɛ mmis n Yahuṣadaq, arrays n ikehhanen, inna:
“Ammu i issawař SIDI n řɛeskar, iqqar: Řgens-a iqqar: ‘Ɛad war dd-yiwiḍ řḥař, řḥař maḥend ad tᵉttwabna Taddart n SIDI ɛawed.’”
Xenni yusa-dd wawař n SIDI s ufus n unabi Ḥaggay, inna:
“Ma yiwed-dd řḥař ḥima kenniw ad tzedɣem di tudrin nwem ittwaseqqfen, am Taddart-a d řxarbet?
Maca řexxu inna SIDI n řɛeskarat: Ḥḍam mliḥ ibriden nwem deg wuřawen nwem ...

Kenniw tzarrɛem aṭṭas, tmejjarem drus. Kenniw tᵉttettem, war tᵉttjjiwinem, kenniw tsessem, maca war iǧi ařami i ɣa tescarem, kenniw tyarḍem arruḍ, maca war issḥemmi, u wenni d ɣa iṭṭfen řmunet, ad iṭṭef řmunet deg ict n tkemmust tᵉnnuqqeb.
Ammu i iqqar SIDI n řɛeskar: Ḥḍam mliḥ ibriden nwem deg wuřawen nwem.
Geɛɛdem adrar, awyem-dd akeccuḍ u bnam Taddart-a u Necc ad xas arḍiɣ u ad zzayes ttwassɛuǧeɣ, inna SIDI.

Kenniw tarrim taynit i waṭṭas n řɣiǧet, maca xzarem, aqa-t mɣir drus u xmi t-i-dd-tᵉttawyem ɣar taddart, Necc ttsuḍeɣ xas. Mayemmi? Ammu i iqqar SIDI n řɛeskarat. Zi ssibbet n Taddart inu tenni idewřen d řxarbet, am kuř ijjen zzaywem ittazzeř x taddart n yixef nnes.
X uya mennɛen xawem ijenwan nnda u tammurt tmenneɛ xawem řɣiǧet nnes.
Necc řaɣiɣ-dd x řekḥeḍ i temmurt, x idurar, x imendi, x binu, x zzect, u x marra min i dd-tᵉttawi temmurt, uřa x iwdan u x řmař u x warber n ifassen.”

Xenni isřa Zarubbabil, mmis n Ca’altiyal, u akides Yahucaɛ, mmis n Yahuṣadaq, arrays n ikehhanen, u marra min iqqimen n řgens, ɣar tmijja n SIDI, AREBBI nsen, u ɣar wawařen n unabi Ḥaggay, am mammec i t issekk SIDI, AREBBI nsen. U nitni, řgens, ggʷeden zzat i wudem n SIDI.
Ibarreḥ Ḥaggay, amsexxar n SIDI, i řgens, inna: “Necc aqa ayi akidwem!” iqqar SIDI.

Uca issekkar SIDI buḥbeř n Zarubbabil, mmis n Ca’altiyal, lwali n Yahuda, uřa d buḥbeř n Yahucaɛ, mmis n Yahuṣadaq, arrays n ikehhanen, uřa d buḥbeř n marra min iqqimen zi řgens u nitni usin-dd u ggin řxedmet di Taddart n SIDI n řɛeskarat, AREBBI nsen.
deg wass wiss arebɛa u-ɛicrin n uyur, deg uyur wiss setta, deg useggʷas wiss tnayen n ujeǧid Dariyus.
